guidance:
Write a product or feature specification under the single Product Specification root. PRD mode uses `<Subject> - Agile PRD`; Feature mode uses `<Subject> - Agile Feature Spec`.
Always state supported context and intent. Use bounded leeway for optional modules: infer repository-supported detail, emphasize initiative context and outcomes in PRD mode, and emphasize behavior and acceptance criteria in Feature mode. Omit optional modules that are irrelevant or unsupported. Do not add invented personas, stakeholders, metrics, traceability, requirements, or upstream documents. Preserve consequential unknowns as open decisions rather than resolving them without evidence.

outline.title: Product Specification
outline.guidance: The complete product or feature specification. Context and Intent is required so this root is always meaningful; omit every optional child module that lacks useful supported content.

children.title: Context and Intent
children.guidance: State the supported current condition, why the subject matters, and the outcome or behavior this document intends to establish. Keep the detail appropriate to the selected mode and do not prescribe unsupported implementation detail.

children.title: Users and Stakeholders
children.guidance: People or systems materially affected by the subject. Omit this module when no useful user or stakeholder information is established.

children.title: User or Stakeholder
children.guidance: Title each instance with the concrete user, stakeholder, or affected system. State only the supported need, responsibility, or impact.

children.title: Outcomes and Success Evidence
children.guidance: Desired outcomes and evidence that would demonstrate them. PRD mode may emphasize this module. Omit it when no separate outcome or evidence entry is useful.

children.title: Outcome or Success Evidence
children.guidance: Title each instance with the concrete desired outcome or evidence. Distinguish a desired result from an established measurement source, and include quantitative measures only when supplied or evidenced.

children.title: Scope and Requirements
children.guidance: Supported scope boundaries, requirements, and material exclusions. Omit this module when Context and Intent already states the complete bounded subject.

children.title: Scope Item or Requirement
children.guidance: Title each instance with the capability, constraint, or boundary. State the required result and relevant conditions without inventing detail. Use identifiers only when they help the document or already govern the work.

children.title: Non-Goal
children.guidance: Title each instance with an excluded capability, behavior, audience, configuration, or integration that materially clarifies scope, and state why it is outside this document. Omit all instances when none adds a useful boundary.

children.title: Behaviors and Journeys
children.guidance: Observable behavior or meaningful journeys. Feature mode may emphasize this module. Omit it when behavior or journey detail is not relevant.

children.title: Behavior or Journey
children.guidance: Title each instance with the observable behavior or journey goal. Describe supported preconditions, interactions, rules, states, outcomes, or recovery where they matter.

children.title: Acceptance Criteria
children.guidance: Observable completion conditions. Feature mode may emphasize this module. Omit it when acceptance criteria are not established by the source.

children.title: Acceptance Criterion
children.guidance: Title each instance with the behavior being evaluated. Use Given / When / Then for an interaction, transition, or flow. For any other observable check, use concise declarative Target and Constraint fields. Add Violation only when a failure response or failure behavior is part of the contract.

children.title: Risks and Dependencies
children.guidance: Material uncertainty, constraints, and external dependencies. Omit this module when none needs recording.

children.title: Risk or Dependency
children.guidance: Title each instance with the concrete concern. State its relevance, likely impact, and known mitigation or dependency condition.

children.title: Open Decisions
children.guidance: Unresolved consequential choices. Omit this module when none exists; do not turn unsupported guesses into settled content.

children.title: Open Decision
children.guidance: Title each instance with the decision needed. State the known options, evidence, trade-offs, and what depends on resolution.
